defects.summary: Optimizer worker launch identity discovery depends on PowerShell/CIM global process enumeration with a fixed 8-second timeout.
defects.evidence: Baseline GitHub Windows push run 37004211038 attempt 1 failed test_windows_venv_worker_resolution_finds_actual_child_process with subprocess.TimeoutExpired in optimizer_jobs._find_worker_by_token while powershell.exe/Get-CimInstance enumerated Win32_Process; reruns of that same baseline did not close the defect. The repair source candidate passed 32 focused identity/recovery/stop tests, 3 repeated real Windows venv tests covering 15/15 worker lifecycles, full backend (483 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed), governance, exact-tree/secret scanning, and both push and PR-head Windows CI across all three jobs. Exact final SHA and CI run identities are external evidence per D-012.
defects.resolution: PowerShell/CIM worker discovery is replaced by a deterministic authenticated one-use named-pipe handshake and native actual-peer PID, executable-path, process-creation-identity, and verified-termination checks. Source and hosted acceptance gates pass on the repair candidate. This remains an unmerged candidate; phase closure and Owner runtime are not claimed.
